F1 · Registry OOXML 预览对第三方 worker 失效没有边界，且 docx/pptx 使用 progressiveLayout

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file · 原评审：未解决

⌄

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/office-open-xml-preview.tsx 为 docx 与 pptx 传入 progressiveLayout: true（xlsx 不传），且三种格式都未向 @silurus/ooxml 传 workerTimeoutMs。该库在 module blob Worker 中解析，worker 启动失败时只 revoke object URL 并吞掉错误，因此 load() 可能永不 settle；宿主不可见/未布局时 progressiveLayout 也会推迟布局。用户只看到 Loading preview...，没有失败原因或下载回退。

实际影响
使用该 registry recipe 的应用必须复制组件并自行加固，否则预览可能永久加载，浏览器验收只能记 blocked 或 failed。
建议改法
registry 组件默认关闭 progressiveLayout（或提供显式选项），传入有界的 workerTimeoutMs，并在 worker 失败时进入可见错误态且保留下载回退；建议附带一次用新 viewer 的重试。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
在全局 Worker 被包装/限制或宿主隐藏的浏览器中打开 DOCX/PPTX 预览
应有能力 / 行为
预览在有界时间内渲染，或进入带原因的失败态并保留下载
实际观察
worker 消息丢失后 load() 永不 settle，界面长期停留在 Loading preview...
应用绕行与代价
把 registry 源码 materialize 进应用，移除 progressiveLayout、传入 workerTimeoutMs、增加 30s 看门狗与一次重试
改进后的验收标准
registry office-open-xml-preview 向查看器传入 worker timeout，成功路径清除看门狗；浏览器用例渲染 fixture 并在超过该超时后仍保留内容

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:233–239E4

Skill 说明 DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 本地渲染、同源凭据限制、Bearer-only 内容的适配方式，以及 OOXML/PDF/text 取数凭据规则。

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.

F12 · source-managed Workflow 物化后默认停用且缺少安装期启用途径

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-workflow · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow · 原评审：未解决

⌄

materializeWorkflowSource 创建 revision 时写 enabled: false；activateWorkflowSource 只继承上一个 current revision 的 enabled。Workflow 服务暴露 trigger 与管理 API，但没有可供 seed 或 Provider 正当调用的启用方法，安装期启用只能由管理员调用管理 API。因此需要在安装后即可被业务事件触发的 source workflow 无法仅靠源码与 seed 生效。

实际影响
应用若把自动流程写成 source workflow，安装后默认不触发，只能改用 typed code 绕过，损失流程可视化与节点历史。
建议改法
提供一个受信任的 provisioning 路径（例如 seed/sync 阶段的启用选项），让安装期可声明初始启用状态，同时保留管理员后续启停。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
用 source workflow 表达安装后即应被业务事件自动触发的流程
应有能力 / 行为
seed/sync 后 revision 处于可触发状态，或存在受信任的启用途径
实际观察
物化 revision 为 enabled:false，服务无启用方法，需管理员手工启用
应用绕行与代价
改用 typed code + 审计表实现自动受理，放弃 Workflow 的节点历史
改进后的验收标准
安装/种子流程能声明初始启用状态且 trigger 返回 accepted，重复安装不覆盖管理员后续的启停配置

export async function activateWorkflowSource(store, workflowId) {
    const selected = await store.workflows.findOne({
        filter: { id: asIdFilter(workflowId) },
        select: (select) => select.fields('key'),
    });
    if (!selected)
        throw new Error(`Workflow ${String(workflowId)} was not found.`);
    const key = String(selected.key);
    const previous = await store.workflows.findOne({
        filter: { key, current: true },
        select: (select) => select.fields('enabled'),
    });
    const inheritedEnabled = previous ? Boolean(previous.enabled) : false;

    // Clear stale state before selecting the new current revision so historical

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/invocation-and-service-api.md:17–24E32

invocation 文档说明业务事件经 workflowRuntime.trigger 传入 workflow key 并得到 accepted/skipped，刻意没有通用公开的 POST /workflows/:key/trigger。

| Business/domain event starts a workflow                 | `workflowRuntime.trigger(key, input, options?)` | workflow key              | `accepted`/`skipped` receipt; accepted execution is asynchronous |
| Authorized administrator manually executes a definition | authenticated management HTTP API               | definition id             | persisted run list item                                          |
| Manage/inspect workflows and runs                       | authenticated management HTTP API               | mostly definition/run ids | typed view/list/detail                                           |
| Browser/admin client                                    | authenticated `/api` routes                     | definition/run ids        | `{ data }` or paged response                                     |

There is intentionally no generic public `POST /workflows/:key/trigger`. A cron, webhook, route, or domain module authenticates and validates its own event, constructs the declared input, then calls the internal service.

### [重要][能力缺口] source-managed Workflow 物化后默认停用且缺少安装期启用途径

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.28）、`packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow`

materializeWorkflowSource 创建 revision 时写 enabled: false；activateWorkflowSource 只继承上一个 current revision 的 enabled。Workflow 服务暴露 trigger 与管理 API，但没有可供 seed 或 Provider 正当调用的启用方法，安装期启用只能由管理员调用管理 API。因此需要在安装后即可被业务事件触发的 source workflow 无法仅靠源码与 seed 生效。

**影响**：应用若把自动流程写成 source workflow，安装后默认不触发，只能改用 typed code 绕过，损失流程可视化与节点历史。

**建议改动**：提供一个受信任的 provisioning 路径（例如 seed/sync 阶段的启用选项），让安装期可声明初始启用状态，同时保留管理员后续启停。

**验收标准**：安装/种子流程能声明初始启用状态且 trigger 返回 accepted，重复安装不覆盖管理员后续的启停配置

- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/invocation-and-service-api.md:17–24` — invocation 文档说明业务事件经 workflowRuntime.trigger 传入 workflow key 并得到 accepted/skipped，刻意没有通用公开的 POST /workflows/:key/trigger。

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file · 原评审：未解决

⌄

OOXML 规范允许省略 xl/styles.xml，但 @silurus/ooxml 在缺失该部件时抛 entry not found: xl/styles.xml，Registry 组件把整个包当作不可读。File Skill 的 OOXML 小节只讲本地渲染与同源凭据，没有提示查看器比规范更严格，也没有稀疏包 fixture。

实际影响
合法但精简的 XLSX 被当作损坏文件，错误信息指向用户文件而非查看器限制，应用需自行补齐样式部件。
建议改法
在 Skill 增加可选部件提醒，registry 在交给查看器前补齐缺失的可选部件（或选择容忍缺失的查看器），并保留一个稀疏包 fixture 作为回归样例。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
预览一个包含 xl/workbook.xml 但省略 xl/styles.xml 的合法 XLSX
应有能力 / 行为
XLSX 正常渲染
实际观察
查看器抛 entry not found: xl/styles.xml，界面显示无法渲染
应用绕行与代价
应用复制 registry 源码，在 load 前用 lib/ooxml-normalize.ts 补齐最小 styles 部件与关系
改进后的验收标准
registry 或 Skill 提供一个缺失 xl/styles.xml 的 fixture，并断言其可渲染或给出明确的查看器限制说明

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/lib/file-preview.ts:111–140E3

resolveFilePreviewKind 按 MIME/扩展名把文件分为 image/pdf/audio/video/text/markdown/ooxml/office/unsupported，并显式屏蔽 HTML/SVG/XML 等活动内容。

export function resolveFilePreviewKind(file: FileRecord): FilePreviewKind {
  const mimeType = file.mimeType.split(';', 1)[0]?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
  const extension = fileExtension(file.filename);
  if (
    ACTIVE_MIME_TYPES.has(mimeType) ||
    mimeType.endsWith('+xml') ||
    ACTIVE_EXTENSIONS.has(extension)
  ) {
    return 'unsupported';
  }
  if (mimeType === 'text/markdown' || extension === '.md') return 'markdown';
  if (resolveOfficeOpenXmlFormat(file)) return 'ooxml';
  if (OFFICE_MIME_TYPES.has(mimeType) || OFFICE_EXTENSIONS.has(extension)) {
    return 'office';
  }
  if (isSafeImagePreview(file)) return 'image';
  if (mimeType === 'application/pdf' || extension === '.pdf') return 'pdf';
  if (mimeType.startsWith('audio/')) return 'audio';
  if (mimeType.startsWith('video/')) return 'video';
  if (
    mimeType.startsWith('text/') ||
    mimeType === 'application/json' ||
    extension === '.json'
  ) {
    return 'text';
  }
  return 'unsupported';
}

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md:65–72E8

Skill 描述注册语义：未注册 collection 对所有人拒绝、composite 只组合其列出的授权、字段与关系操作代码拥有、关系写不继承目标集合约束。

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.database.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from the database; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- `settings`, `composite` and `database.collection` are catalog types: a check on an unregistered item or action is denied with `RESOURCE_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. `page`, `user`, `notification` and Hub types are record types that declare actions only; their grants use `id: '*'` for every record.
- A composite action composes exactly the grants it lists, never another composite. A data scope targets the one collection its grant actions name, whose type must declare `recordAccess` (`database.collection` does). Grant page access separately; a page grant never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require` needs an unconditional permit and rejects conditional decisions. Business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial or missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving collection grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the Repository route definition and bind each method to its composite action with `authz.database.authorizeRepository`. Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions need custom handlers. `authz.database.policyFor` folds collection grants; without its third argument it does not respect a business-action boundary.
- Scope every read and write in the workflow, including parent lookups. Keep multi-record writes transactional and include expected business state in mutation predicates. Authorization does not validate a quote's amount or its workflow transition.
- Fields and relation operations are code-owned. The permission workspace configures pages, business actions, their data scopes and settings items; do not build a second raw-field permission editor.
- Relation writes do not inherit the target collection's standalone constraints. Declare target record access and join-table fields explicitly; keep foreign-key fields from bypassing association controls.
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md:29–33E9

Skill 要求用岗位表达权限集、用记录范围表达归属，并明确一人可同时持有直接岗位与继承团队岗位、撤销一个来源应保留另一个。

Before writing grants, turn the requirement into a matrix: actor/job, page, business action, allowed records, readable/writable fields, relation operations and exceptions. Identify who administers assignments separately from who uses the business feature. Ask only about missing decisions that affect access; record concrete assumptions and continue independent modeling work.

Use jobs as permission sets, such as sales engineer or delivery specialist. Ownership, region and assigned projects are record scopes, not extra role names. A person may hold a direct job plus an inherited team job. Define whether revoking one source should preserve the other. Describe each exception as a business fact: a delegated quote, a confidential project, or an active delivery team.

The sales example separates quote preparation from regional submission responsibility: an engineer can edit their own out-of-region draft but cannot submit it unless the parent project is also accessible. This is a useful model for multi-table operations; copy the responsibility boundary, not its fixture IDs, demo accounts or reset endpoint.

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler/references/targets.md:80–100E19

references 要求检查 dispatch→业务 worker→终态通知→持久恢复全链路，reportCompletion 只在真实终态调用，inspect 恢复同一执行且不得重写历史。

Review the complete execution chain: dispatch → business worker consumption → terminal notification → persisted-state recovery. Scheduler runs its `schedule` worker only; the actual business worker must also be running on the selected connection/queue. Reconciliation observes execution state and cannot consume or execute the business Job.

In addition to dispatch and consumption, an asynchronous target needs all of the following:

1. **Terminal notification:** `registerTarget()` returns a handle; call `handle.reportCompletion(occurrenceId, reference, completion)` after actual success or exhausted retries. A failed attempt that will retry is not terminal failure. The handle only completes occurrences its own target started, so keep it on the Provider rather than re-deriving it. Queue Jobs are constructed through the application queue provider's Job factory, which supplies shared infrastructure such as database and logger rather than the application container; pass the handle through an explicit factory or service you own and do not assume a Job has `this.app`.
2. **Recovery queries:** implement `inspect(reference)` on the target and query persisted execution state. Reconciliation routes by the target type the occurrence recorded when it started, so a definition later retargeted elsewhere still inspects through the target that began the run.
3. **Reliable references:** notifications and inspection use the same `{ type, id }`, recoverable across processes. Do not use an in-process Map as the authoritative terminal state. Other execution systems use their own stable, non-conflicting reference types.

Queue Job success does not automatically mark Scheduler success. Returning `accepted` alone is incomplete. A notification can be lost or arrive before acceptance is persisted; inspection compensates for these cases. Nothing observes a Queue Job for you.

## Historical Occurrences After Retargeting

Changing a definition's target affects later executions; it does not transfer ownership of an existing occurrence. For example, if a definition changes from `app.export` to `workflow` while an export is waiting, that occurrence still belongs to `app.export`.

A valid completion requires all three conditions together:

1. Use the handle registered for the original target type recorded on the occurrence, not the new definition target's handle. Keep the original target integration available while its executions remain outstanding; a process restart can register that same type again.
2. Supply the original occurrenceId and its accepted reference, matching both `reference.type` and `reference.id`. Knowing the occurrenceId or original target type alone is insufficient. An ownership or reference mismatch is rejected with `REFERENCE_MISMATCH`.
3. Report the real executor's terminal outcome, after success or final failure rather than an attempt that will retry. A duplicate report of the same terminal status is idempotent; a conflicting terminal status is rejected with `COMPLETION_CONFLICT`.

If notification arrives before the accepted reference is persisted, it can return without completing the occurrence. Verify persisted history and let `inspect()` recover the original execution's state. Recovery routes through the occurrence's recorded target type and reference; do not launch replacement work or rewrite history to make a callback match.

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Repair round 2 addressed the browser-QA failures observed in verify-2 for the Chinese device after-sales service and inspection application. Fixes: a missing auth guard caused GET /service-engineers 500; the client referenced 371 service.* translation keys that did not exist (new service-en/service-zh locale modules spread into en-US/zh-CN with compile-time parity); collaborator and observer access rules were corrected server- and client-side (an observer now reads the non-confidential register with laborHours/internalCost masked and no write path, including attachment upload/delete); createOne calls now write timestamps so POST /service-customers and /service-devices no longer 500; order transitions write a createdAt so the history no longer errors; uploads validate size/type/signature and surface the real reason; assistant references JSON is parsed; the dashboard gained region/priority filters plus region and engineer distributions; a scheduler-based recurring inspection/order-overdue provider replaced a private cron manager and the weekly plan frequency was corrected; automatic acceptance now records its steps in the order history with retained failures and idempotent retry; a new seed adds the missing regional/collaborator/observer roles, service teams with a workspace-selectable subject type and inheritance, order collaborations (including a confidential one that stays invisible), the order recovery example and in-box messages. All checks (format, lint, three typechecks, 309 tests) pass; db apply and the seed were validated on a fresh database, and a standalone boot confirmed the three schedules sync, team inheritance resolves without a direct role, and the observer/collaborator/coordinator record scopes behave as intended. Repair round 3 addressed the verify-3 browser-QA defects. Group 1: POST /service-devices no longer writes an explicit null into the NOT NULL service_devices.category column when the form leaves Category blank, so the database default applies and the create succeeds; the values assembly was extracted as deviceCreateValues and covered by tests/logic/service-device-create.test.ts. Group 2: every application Select root now passes items so the closed trigger and form dropdowns render translated labels instead of raw stored values (customer id, running status, order priority/source, and the all/__all__ filter sentinels); the missing service.level.basic value was added to SERVICE_LEVELS and both service locale files; and server-side rejections were moved from hard-coded Chinese to request-locale keys via server/services/errors.ts plus typed server/locales en-US/zh-CN, covered by tests/logic/server-error-locale.test.ts. The relevant self-tests (device-create, server-error-locale, locale-coverage, client-routes), Prettier, ESLint and all three typechecks pass. Repair round 4 addressed the verify-4 browser-QA failures around cross-region knowledge sharing and the inspection execution view. Group 1: migration 202609010007 adds the application-owned knowledge_shares table (articleId, teamId, teamName, region, reason, grantedById, grantedByName, active, revokedAt, timestamps, unique articleId+teamId) and an inspection_plans.timezone column; server/routes/knowledge.ts now resolves the caller's service-team memberships (Caller.teamIds), keeps a restricted article to coordinators, its author and explicitly shared teams, exposes GET /knowledge-share-teams, GET/POST /knowledge-articles/:id/shares and POST .../shares/:shareId/revoke, and returns canShare per row; the knowledge page gained a cross-region share dialog with per-team revoke. Group 2: the inspection page shows each plan's timezone and the plan form edits it, and a new 'Schedules & history' tab reads GET /api/schedules and GET /api/schedules/:id/occurrences (enable/disable via POST) so the schedule name, cron, timezone, enable state, next/last run, run counts and each execution's status/reason/start/finish/result are visible. Seed 202609010008 turns the catch-all '华东区域通用设备周巡检' into a daily plan (the root cause of 'Generated 0 task(s)' and a newly added device producing no task), backfills plan timezones, grants page:scheduler.schedules access plus settings:scheduler.schedules read to every permission set that reaches the inspection page, seeds one worked cross-region share to ST-SOUTH, and corrects the matching in-app notice. The article-visibility rule was extracted into server/services/knowledge.ts and planDueOn exported for test; new tests/logic/knowledge-sharing.test.ts and tests/logic/inspection-schedule.test.ts cover coordinator/author/team access, revocation, customer/integrator exclusion, catch-all daily coverage and the weekly non-Monday gap. All three typechecks, Prettier, ESLint on the touched files and 325 tests pass. Repair round 5 (incomplete when its process was killed, completed and verified in repair round 6) addressed the verify-6 browser-QA failures. Group 1: the customer, device and order lists gained a region filter (previously only the dashboard had one) — the order list now sends region to GET /service-orders and the server filters visible orders, while the customer and device lists filter the fetched rows, deriving a device's region from its customer; /service-regions supplies the distinct values. Group 2: attachment preview was made robust — a valid XLSX that omitted the optional xl/styles.xml is completed before loading so the Office viewer no longer reports 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.', and PDFs are rendered to canvases in the dialog's own document with pdfjs-dist instead of the browser's built-in viewer, which had navigated the tab to about:blank and dropped the session. Group 3: orders created from the report form now inherit their region from the device or, when the device has none, from its customer, and migration 202609010009 backfills the region of existing orders so the dashboard's region distribution covers every order. Repair round 6 confirmed each fix against the factory browser fixtures (raw vs normalized XLSX in headless Chromium, and the pdfjs canvas path on sample.pdf), added tests/logic/order-create-region.test.ts, removed a leftover staged .tmp-ooxml-test/ scratch directory, and reran Prettier, ESLint on the touched files, all three typechecks and the relevant logic tests (22 passed). Repair round 7 addressed the verify-7 browser-QA defect that the root/unrestricted account (nocobase) saw no options in the customer, device and order Region filters while its dashboard region filter was complete. Root cause: hasRole() short-circuits to true for isRoot, so the restricting predicates isCustomer/isIntegrator/isObserver all returned true for root; isCustomer then scoped those lists to caller.customerId (null for root) and returned empty, while /dashboard/summary checks isCoordinator first and therefore still listed every region. Fixed by adding hasExplicitRole() to server/services/access.ts and using it for isCustomer, isIntegrator and isObserver, so root is unrestricted rather than impersonating a restriction role; isCoordinator and isEngineer keep the root bypass. Added tests/logic/access-roles.test.ts pinning that root is a coordinator/writer/internal-field reader but not a customer, integrator or observer, and that explicit roles still match. Touched-file Prettier, ESLint and tsconfig.server typecheck pass, plus the four relevant logic test files (16 tests). Repair round 8 addressed the verify-8 browser-QA defect that the device and customer list search boxes did not reset pagination: an onChange that only called setSearch left the page on a now non-existent page, so a one-page result rendered as an empty page with the indicator showing "2 / 1". Both search handlers now also call setPage(1), matching the existing region/status filters, and a new tests/components/service-list-search-pagination.test.tsx renders both lists against fixed fixtures, moves to page 2, searches a code that lives on page 1 and asserts "1 / 1" with no "2 / 1". The new test, touched-file Prettier, ESLint and the client tsc typecheck pass. Repair round 9 addressed five verify-9 browser-QA defects. (1) The customer and device edit dialogs kept the values typed into a previous failed submission because they stay mounted across opens and merge local overrides over the newly selected record; each is now remounted per open session with a state-derived key, covered by tests/components/service-customer-form.test.tsx. (2) The reassign dialog had no reason field and the history recorded no reason: the dialog now requires a reason when the order already has an assignee, assignOrder() sends it, the server rejects a reassignment without one (400 assignReasonRequired) and writes the reason into the order log, covered by tests/components/order-assign-reason.test.tsx. (3) The customer Region field was not required and a blank value caused a NOT NULL 500 because customerValues() wrote an explicit null: the form validates it client-side with per-field feedback, the create route answers 400 customerRegionRequired, and an update that omits it leaves the stored value alone; covered by tests/logic/service-customer-region.test.ts. (4) The dashboard Knowledge articles count ignored article permissions (6 vs 5) because the dashboard never applied canReadArticle; a shared visibleArticles() helper now drives both the list and the count, covered by a new case in tests/logic/knowledge-sharing.test.ts. (5) The docx/pptx previews that the harness reported stuck on "Loading preview..." could not be reproduced under plain Chrome/Playwright, the real agent-browser CLI, CPU throttling or background-tab emulation; the strongest source difference (progressiveLayout, used only by docx/pptx while the working xlsx does not) was removed, the translator identity was stabilized through a ref, and a bounded 30s timeout now surfaces the real error instead of an endless spinner, covered by a fake-timer case in tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx. Touched-file Prettier, ESLint, the client and server typechecks and the 41 relevant tests pass; the docx/pptx path still needs a full browser re-verification. Repair round 10 addressed two verify-10 browser-QA defects. (1) A customer's Remark field was sent on update but came back null and was blank after a refresh because customerValues() in server/routes/service-data.ts never copied body.remark; it now trims and persists the value (null when omitted), covered by extended cases in tests/logic/service-customer-region.test.ts. (2) The New order dialog had no save-as-draft path - both of its buttons created pending_assignment orders - and opening the seeded Draft SO-2026-0007 and choosing Move to Pending assignment left the status at Draft: the form now carries an explicit draft/submit intent behind named Save draft and Submit buttons (a draft may omit the fault description and skips automatic acceptance), and the order detail page now takes the server's per-order availableTransitions list (added to GET /service-orders/:id) so a plain advance applies in one click while a reason-bearing move opens the dialog; returning a finished order now requires a reason. Covered by tests/logic/order-draft-submit.test.ts, tests/logic/order-create-payload.test.ts, tests/components/order-create-dialog.test.tsx, tests/components/order-transition-actions.test.tsx and tests/logic/order-transition-route.test.ts. Touched-file Prettier, ESLint, the client and server typechecks and the 42 relevant tests pass.

问题 02 · lint

eslint no-base-to-string across server routes and services

本任务已处理

pnpm lint --ignore-pattern '.github/**' failed with about 102 no-base-to-string errors where String(value) or template interpolation was applied to RepositoryRecord field values.

原因（实现者自述）
RepositoryRecord is Record<string, RepositoryMutationScalarValue>; the value union includes objects and arrays, so String() on it can stringify '[object Object]' and eslint forbids it.
处理方式
Added a single toText(value: unknown): string helper in server/services/text.ts (null/undefined to '', strings as-is, number/bigint/boolean via String(), Date via toString(), otherwise '') and replaced the flagged stringifications across server routes and services. Verified String() on narrowed primitives is lint-safe.

问题 06 · typecheck

TS2339 from .catch(() => ({})) fallback unions

本任务已处理

tsc -p tsconfig.server.json reported Property 'X' does not exist on type 'Record<string, unknown> | {}' in server/routes/inspections.ts, integrations.ts and service-assistant.ts.

原因（实现者自述）
A fetch JSON parse typed as .json<Record<string, unknown>>() chained with .catch(() => ({})) inferred a union with the empty object literal, so member access on the result was not allowed.
处理方式
Typed the fallback explicitly with .catch((): Record<string, unknown> => ({})) instead of using an as assertion, which would have tripped no-unnecessary-type-assertion. tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit passes.

问题 07 · test

Source-loaded seeds could not resolve sibling .js specifiers

本任务已处理

tests/logic/app-server.test.ts failed: Cannot find module '/workspace/database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from database/main/seeds/202609010002_permission_sets.ts (and the same for '../../../server/roles.js').

原因（实现者自述）
The seed loader imports an application seed as TypeScript source, but Node type stripping does not rewrite a .js specifier to a sibling .ts file. The seeds were not self-contained: one imported database/seed-data/permission-sets.js and the other imported shared role and order-status constants from server/roles.js.
处理方式
Made both seeds self-contained by spelling the role keys, page ids, settings targets, user actions and order statuses out locally, then deleted database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts and updated the comment in client/routes.ts. This matches the rule that seeds are applied history and must not import a shared constant that keeps evolving.

问题 35 · browser-QA

本任务已处理

原因（实现者自述）
hasRole() in server/services/access.ts returns true for every caller.isRoot, so isCustomer(root), isIntegrator(root) and isObserver(root) all matched. /service-regions (and the customer/device list handlers) filtered records with isCustomer(caller), scoping root to caller.customerId === null and yielding nothing. The dashboard region list was unaffected only because listVisibleOrders checks isCoordinator before isCustomer.
处理方式
Added a private hasExplicitRole() that checks caller.roles without the root bypass and used it for the restricting predicates isCustomer, isIntegrator and isObserver; isCoordinator and isEngineer keep the root bypass so root remains unrestricted. /service-regions now returns every region for root. Covered by tests/logic/access-roles.test.ts (root is coordinator/writer/internal-field reader, not customer/integrator/observer; explicit jobs still match). 问题 41 · browser-QA

DOCX and PPTX previews stayed on "Loading preview..." (not reproduced; hardened)

本任务已处理

The harness reported the docx and pptx attachments stuck on "Loading preview..." while png, pdf and xlsx rendered. The fixture fetched the correct bytes twice with HTTP 200 for docx/pptx during the run.

原因（实现者自述）
Not reproducible: the same built chunks rendered docx and pptx correctly under plain Chrome/Playwright, under the real agent-browser CLI, and under CPU throttling and background-tab emulation, so no single environment-owned cause could be confirmed. The strongest source-level difference is that docx/pptx passed `progressiveLayout: true` while the working xlsx viewer did not; progressiveLayout publishes layout only once the host is laid out and visible, which a hidden/unmeasured dialog host can postpone, leaving `load` pending. A t-identity change could also have destroyed the viewer mid-load through the effect dependency.
处理方式
Removed `progressiveLayout` from the docx and pptx options (matching xlsx), stabilized the translator through a ref updated in an effect so a locale/namespace identity change cannot abort an in-flight load, and added a bounded 30s timeout (OFFICE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS) that moves a never-settling viewer to the real error state instead of an endless spinner. Documented the observability gap rather than touching the harness. Added a fake-timer case to tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx asserting the timeout surface. Repeated full browser re-verification is still required.

问题 43 · browser-QA

New order could not be saved as a draft, and a Draft did not visibly advance

本任务已处理

The New order form's Create button and an unnamed in-form submit both created pending_assignment orders (SO-2026-0019, SO-2026-0020); there was no way to save a draft. Opening the seeded Draft SO-2026-0007 and choosing Move to Pending assignment left the status at Draft, so assign/handle/confirm/reject/close could not be exercised.

原因（实现者自述）
The create form had no draft concept: both submit paths always posted without a status, so the server always created pending_assignment. On the detail page the transition button opened a confirmation dialog even for a plain advance, and the page chose which transitions to offer from the caller's role (NEXT_STATUSES filtered by canWrite) rather than from the server's per-order decision, which made the click leave the status unchanged when the dialog was not completed.
处理方式
The create dialog now distinguishes intent: named Save draft and Submit buttons set a shared intent ref, the payload sends status=draft only for a draft, the server keys off body.status (draft needs no fault description and skips automatic acceptance), and mayTransition allows the reporter or customer to submit their own draft. GET /service-orders/:id now returns availableTransitions computed with mayTransition, and the detail page consumes it: a transition that needs no input (submit a draft, start assigned work, close a confirmed order) applies in one click, while one that records a reason or result (cancel, resolution, returning a finished order) opens the dialog, which now also requires a return reason. Covered by new order-draft-submit, order-create-payload, order-create-dialog, order-transition-actions and order-transition-route tests.

问题 44 · browser-QA

A rendered OOXML preview self-destructed at 30s, and a stalled viewer worker had no bound and no retry

本任务已处理

The harness reported the docx, xlsx and pptx attachments stuck on "Loading preview...". Re-checking the built artifact showed all three do render in about 3s, but the preview then disappeared: at t~31s the canvas was removed and the dialog showed role=alert "Unable to render this Office Open XML file.", with no console or page error. With the parser worker made inert (Worker.prototype.postMessage no-op) the dialog instead stayed on "Loading preview..." indefinitely.

原因（实现者自述）
Two defects in office-open-xml-preview.tsx. (1) OFFICE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS was armed at effect start but cleared only in the effect cleanup, never after load() succeeded, so a correctly rendered preview was destroyed and replaced by the error state when the 30s timer fired. (2) The @silurus/ooxml parse runs in a module blob Worker; workerTimeoutMs was never passed, and the library's worker bridge has no default timeout, while its Worker error listener only revokes the object URL and swallows the failure - so a worker that fails to start (its module bootstrap is racy in some browsers, as the harness's own minimal module-worker test showed) leaves load() pending forever. The harness polled for at most 12s, so it captured the loading state before the timeout would have fired.
处理方式
Cleared the outer timeout on every path that settles load (success, per-attempt failure, and reportViewerError), so a rendered preview can no longer be torn down. Passed a bounded workerTimeoutMs (OFFICE_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS = 8s) so a dead worker rejects instead of hanging, and retried once with a fresh viewer (OFFICE_LOAD_ATTEMPTS = 2) so a transient worker failure recovers; each attempt receives its own copy of the buffer because load() transfers it to the worker. Verified live in a headless Chromium against order SO-2026-0010: docx (823x1065), xlsx (870x413) and pptx (823x463) render by ~3s and persist with no role=alert through t=34s; with Worker.postMessage no-op'd the dialog reaches the "Unable to render" alert at ~20s instead of spinning forever; png (32x32) and pdf (918x1188 canvas) previews are unchanged. Extended tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx to 8 cases: workerTimeoutMs is passed, the timeout is cleared on success, a stalled first load retries and renders, and a never-settling load reaches the alert.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

阅读批注

报告资料说明

本轮只有失败路径复测记录，不代表全量验收通过。

阅读批注

报告资料说明

本轮浏览器报告未通过。

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 验收机制

Verify script short-circuits after the first failing stage

可自动化

The reported failure was Prettier formatting on five files, but format:check runs early in .github/scripts/verify.sh, so lint, typecheck, test and build never ran in the failing job. Only after fixing formatting did the real failures surface, which made a one-line-looking repair a five-stage repair.

建议改动

Run all verification stages and report every failure in one pass (or run a cheap aggregate smoke stage first), so a repair agent sees the whole failure set instead of discovering it one stage at a time.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · scaffolding

Catch a server-only dependency in devDependencies before the build

可自动化

@nocobase/cron was imported by server/providers/inspections.ts but listed only in devDependencies. Development and typecheck both succeeded; only the build's 'Verify server dependencies' step caught it, because that is when dist/package.json is generated.

建议改动

Expose the server-dependency check as its own fast lint-like command and run it during development (for example from typecheck or a pre-commit hook), so the mistake is reported at the edit that introduces it rather than at the end of the pipeline.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · documentation

Seeds must be self-contained and cannot import sibling source modules

需人工判断

Both application seeds imported external modules with .js specifiers; the test suite loads seeds as TypeScript source, where Node type stripping does not rewrite .js to a sibling .ts. This is easy to miss because application server code uses the same .js-in-source convention successfully after compilation.

建议改动

State explicitly in the seeds/migrations guidance that a seed file must not import any application source module (including role or status constants) and must spell shared values out locally, with the source-loaded test failure as the reason.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 · 验收机制

Browser-QA criteria must be re-checked against the built artifact

需人工判断

Several verify-2 findings were already stale: OOXML/PDF attachment preview worked live, and order keyword search was present in source and bundle. Re-verifying each finding against the current build before rewriting code avoids repairing behaviour that already works and focuses effort on the real failures.

建议改动

Before repair, re-run the exact QA action against the current build and record the observed result; treat only reproduced failures as defects.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 05 · i18n

A large key set is easier to keep parity-checked in its own module

需人工判断

377 service.* keys spread into en-US/zh-CN as two LocaleResource-typed modules made English/Chinese parity a compile error and kept the base locale files small.

建议改动

For a feature with a large string set, keep its keys in a dedicated LocaleResource-typed module and spread them into the base locale, rather than growing the base file.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 06 · workflow

Source-managed workflows cannot be enabled without an administrator

需人工判断

WorkflowService exposes no enable method and materialized source workflows default to enabled:false, so an automatically firing workflow would require an admin API call that a seed or provider cannot legitimately make. The acceptance flow was therefore implemented as ordinary typed code with its own history records.

建议改动

When a requirement is to record the steps of an automatic process, prefer application-owned typed code plus audit/history rows over a workflow that cannot be enabled at install time.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 07 · authorization

A record-scope helper must enumerate every job, not just the restrictive ones

需人工判断

The collaborator/engineer scope was written before the observer existed, so the observer fell through to the most restrictive branch and silently saw nothing. The masking and write guards were correct but unobservable, which would have read as a broken page.

建议改动

When a role is added, add it to every scope list (visibility, field masking, and write) and cover each role with a visible positive and negative case, so a missing entry fails a check instead of producing an empty, plausible-looking result.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 08 · authorization

A registered subject type is not administrable without a selection

需人工判断

Inheritance worked end to end with only resolveFor/filterActive, but the permission workspace could not name a team until administration.selection was added. Runtime correctness and administrative usability are separate obligations of the same registration.

建议改动

Register every application subject type with both the resolution hooks and an administration selection, and verify the subject appears in the inspector options.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 09 · testing

Cover the values a create writes against each NOT NULL column

可自动化

The device create 500 was a NOT NULL violation caused by writing an explicit null for a field the form left blank, even though the column has a database default. No test exercised the values a create assembles, so the regression was only visible at runtime.

建议改动

Assemble a handler's insert/update values in an exported pure function and unit test the absent, blank and supplied cases for every NOT NULL/defaulted column, so a missing field is a test failure rather than a 500.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 10 · frontend

A Select without items silently shows the stored value

可自动化

Base UI's Select renders its closed trigger from the items prop. Omitting it compiles and typechecks, and only shows up at runtime as an id or enum being displayed, which is easy to miss across many forms and filters.

建议改动

Wrap the Select primitive so items is required (or so SelectValue falls back to a provided label renderer), and add a repository scan or lint rule that fails when an application Select has no items.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 11 · i18n

Server-produced text bypasses the client locale system

可自动化

Route handlers returned hard-coded Chinese sentences; the client already preferred the server message, so the user's chosen language was ignored for every rejected write, not only the one defect that was reported.

建议改动

Give the server its own locale resources and a semantic error-key helper by default, and check in tests that a rejection for each language differs from the key and from the other language.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 12 · frontend

An OOXML viewer can require parts the format marks optional

需人工判断

xl/styles.xml is optional per OOXML and a valid small-exporter file omitted it, but @silurus/ooxml requires the part and refused the whole document. The failure surfaced only as a generic 'unreadable file' message, which pointed at the file rather than at the viewer's stricter requirement.

建议改动

Before handing a document to a strict viewer, complete missing optional package parts (and keep a fixture that reproduces the sparse package), or choose a viewer that tolerates them.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 13 · frontend

Render previews in the application's own document

需人工判断

A PDF shown through the browser's built-in viewer lives in a nested frame the application cannot inspect, so a failure is an empty page and the frame can navigate away and take the session with it; an in-page canvas render produces a visible, localized reason.

建议改动

Prefer in-document rendering (canvas/HTML) for previews the application must be able to explain, reserving iframes for content that is genuinely third-party.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 14 · 验收机制

Reproduce a preview defect against the real viewer, not by reading code

可自动化

Both preview defects were settled by loading the factory fixtures in a headless browser: the raw XLSX failed with 'entry not found: xl/styles.xml' and the normalized one loaded, and the pdfjs path rendered the sample PDF. Reading the viewer options alone would not have proved the sparse package was the cause.

建议改动

For third-party viewer defects, add a small browser harness that loads the exact fixture and asserts the rendered result, and keep the fixture in the repository.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 15 · 验收机制

Repair scratch harnesses must be removed before handoff

可自动化

The previous repair left a staged .tmp-ooxml-test/ directory (index.html, main.js, sample.xlsx) in the repository; it was not gitignored and would have shipped with the application.

建议改动

Put repair scratch work under an ignored tmp/ directory (or delete and unstage it as the last step) and add .tmp-*/ to .gitignore so a scratch harness cannot be committed by accident.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 16 · authorization

A root/unrestricted bypass must not satisfy restricting role predicates

可自动化

hasRole() was written for permission checks, where root passing every job is intended, but isCustomer/isIntegrator/isObserver reused it to decide record scope, so root became every restriction role at once and the customer scope (null id) emptied three lists. The dashboard escaped notice because it checks coordinator first.

建议改动

Separate "may do this job" from "is this kind of subject": give granting predicates the root bypass and make restricting/scoping predicates check explicit role membership, and unit test each predicate for root.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 17 · frontend

A dialog that stays mounted across opens must reset its own draft state

可自动化

Two separate browser failures (a stale New-customer draft, and a device form) came from the same shape: a form dialog rendered once with a controlled `open` keeps local `values` between opens. A reset effect is the obvious fix but the repository ESLint config (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) forbids setState in an effect body.

建议改动

When adding a form dialog, remount it per open session with a state-derived `key` (e.g. `formOpen ? record?.id ?? "new" : "closed"`) instead of resetting local state in an effect. Record the pattern in the frontend reference so new pages do not reintroduce it.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 18 · 验收机制

A preview that only fails inside the harness needs a bounded failure path and an artifact

需人工判断

The docx/pptx hang could not be reproduced outside the QA session; the only durable evidence was the fixture fetch log. A viewer that can hang leaves no diagnostic and no recovery for the user.

建议改动

For any async third-party renderer, add an explicit timeout that surfaces the real error state (and keeps the download fallback), and have the QA harness capture a screenshot plus the viewer console output when a preview stays on its loading placeholder.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 19 · frontend

A timer that guards a failure must be cleared by the success path too

可自动化

OFFICE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS was cleared only in the effect cleanup, so a preview that rendered correctly was still destroyed and replaced by the error state when the timer later fired. The test only asserted that a never-settling viewer reaches the alert, which stayed green while the success path was broken.

建议改动

Whenever a watchdog timer is armed for an async operation, clear it in the operation's success path as well as its failure and cleanup paths, and add a fake-timer test that advances past the bound after a successful resolve and asserts the result is retained.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 20 · frontend

A third-party worker-backed renderer needs a bounded request and one retry

可自动化

@silurus/ooxml parses in an inline module blob Worker. workerTimeoutMs was omitted, the bridge has no default timeout, and the library swallows a worker that fails to start, so a racy worker bootstrap produced an infinite "Loading preview..." with no diagnostic. A fresh viewer recovers the common transient case.

建议改动

When handing work to a third-party worker, pass its per-request timeout option so a dead worker rejects into the visible error state, and rebuild the viewer once before surfacing the failure; assert the timeout is passed in the component test.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 21 · 验收机制

Assert the browser lifecycle of a preview, not only that its loader ran

需人工判断

The unit test asserted that viewer.load was called once and stayed green through both defects, because neither the deferred timer nor the worker bound is visible in a mocked load. The real failure was only observable by polling the rendered canvas in a browser.

建议改动

For a document/preview component, keep the mocked unit test for wiring and add a small browser check that renders the exact fixture, polls the canvas, and asserts the content is still present after the component's own timeout would have elapsed.

来源：Agent · retro.json

      "rootCause": "Two defects in office-open-xml-preview.tsx. (1) OFFICE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS was armed at effect start but cleared only in the effect cleanup, never after load() succeeded, so a correctly rendered preview was destroyed and replaced by the error state when the 30s timer fired. (2) The @silurus/ooxml parse runs in a module blob Worker; workerTimeoutMs was never passed, and the library's worker bridge has no default timeout, while its Worker error listener only revokes the object URL and swallows the failure - so a worker that fails to start (its module bootstrap is racy in some browsers, as the harness's own minimal module-worker test showed) leaves load() pending forever.       "resolution": "Cleared the outer timeout on every path that settles load (success, per-attempt failure, and reportViewerError), so a rendered preview can no longer be torn down. Verified live in a headless Chromium against order SO-2026-0010: docx (823x1065), xlsx (870x413) and pptx (823x463) render by ~3s and persist with no role=alert through t=34s; with Worker.postMessage no-op'd the dialog reaches the \"Unable to render\" alert at ~20s instead of spinning forever; png (32x32) and pdf (918x1188 canvas) previews are unchanged. Extended tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx to 8 cases: workerTimeoutMs is passed, the timeout is cleared on success, a stalled first load retries and renders, and a never-settling load reaches the alert.",

    }

      "category": "workflow",
      "title": "Source-managed workflows cannot be enabled without an administrator",
      "detail": "WorkflowService exposes no enable method and materialized source workflows default to enabled:false, so an automatically firing workflow would require an admin API call that a seed or provider cannot legitimately make. The acceptance flow was therefore implemented as ordinary typed code with its own history records.",
      "suggestedChange": "When a requirement is to record the steps of an automatic process, prefer application-owned typed code plus audit/history rows over a workflow that cannot be enabled at install time.",
      "mechanizable": false

    {

      "title": "A record-scope helper must enumerate every job, not just the restrictive ones",
      "detail": "The collaborator/engineer scope was written before the observer existed, so the observer fell through to the most restrictive branch and silently saw nothing. The masking and write guards were correct but unobservable, which would have read as a broken page.",
      "suggestedChange": "When a role is added, add it to every scope list (visibility, field masking, and write) and cover each role with a visible positive and negative case, so a missing entry fails a check instead of producing an empty, plausible-looking result.",

    },
    {
      "category": "authorization",
      "title": "A registered subject type is not administrable without a selection",
      "detail": "Inheritance worked end to end with only resolveFor/filterActive, but the permission workspace could not name a team until administration.selection was added. Runtime correctness and administrative usability are separate obligations of the same registration.",

      "mechanizable": false
    },
    {
      "category": "testing",
      "title": "Cover the values a create writes against each NOT NULL column",
      "detail": "The device create 500 was a NOT NULL violation caused by writing an explicit null for a field the form left blank, even though the column has a database default. No test exercised the values a create assembles, so the regression was only visible at runtime.",
      "suggestedChange": "Assemble a handler's insert/update values in an exported pure function and unit test the absent, blank and supplied cases for every NOT NULL/defaulted column, so a missing field is a test failure rather than a 500.",
      "mechanizable": true
    },
    {
      "category": "frontend",
      "title": "A Select without items silently shows the stored value",
      "detail": "Base UI's Select renders its closed trigger from the items prop. Omitting it compiles and typechecks, and only shows up at runtime as an id or enum being displayed, which is easy to miss across many forms and filters.",
      "suggestedChange": "Wrap the Select primitive so items is required (or so SelectValue falls back to a provided label renderer), and add a repository scan or lint rule that fails when an application Select has no items.",
      "mechanizable": true
    },

      "category": "i18n",
      "title": "Server-produced text bypasses the client locale system",
      "detail": "Route handlers returned hard-coded Chinese sentences; the client already preferred the server message, so the user's chosen language was ignored for every rejected write, not only the one defect that was reported.",
      "suggestedChange": "Give the server its own locale resources and a semantic error-key helper by default, and check in tests that a rejection for each language differs from the key and from the other language.",
      "mechanizable": true

      "title": "An OOXML viewer can require parts the format marks optional",
      "detail": "xl/styles.xml is optional per OOXML and a valid small-exporter file omitted it, but @silurus/ooxml requires the part and refused the whole document. The failure surfaced only as a generic 'unreadable file' message, which pointed at the file rather than at the viewer's stricter requirement.",
      "suggestedChange": "Before handing a document to a strict viewer, complete missing optional package parts (and keep a fixture that reproduces the sparse package), or choose a viewer that tolerates them.",
      "mechanizable": false

      "title": "Render previews in the application's own document",
      "detail": "A PDF shown through the browser's built-in viewer lives in a nested frame the application cannot inspect, so a failure is an empty page and the frame can navigate away and take the session with it; an in-page canvas render produces a visible, localized reason.",
      "suggestedChange": "Prefer in-document rendering (canvas/HTML) for previews the application must be able to explain, reserving iframes for content that is genuinely third-party.",
      "mechanizable": false

      "title": "Reproduce a preview defect against the real viewer, not by reading code",
      "detail": "Both preview defects were settled by loading the factory fixtures in a headless browser: the raw XLSX failed with 'entry not found: xl/styles.xml' and the normalized one loaded, and the pdfjs path rendered the sample PDF. Reading the viewer options alone would not have proved the sparse package was the cause.",
      "suggestedChange": "For third-party viewer defects, add a small browser harness that loads the exact fixture and asserts the rendered result, and keep the fixture in the repository.",
      "mechanizable": true

      "detail": "The previous repair left a staged .tmp-ooxml-test/ directory (index.html, main.js, sample.xlsx) in the repository; it was not gitignored and would have shipped with the application.",
      "suggestedChange": "Put repair scratch work under an ignored tmp/ directory (or delete and unstage it as the last step) and add .tmp-*/ to .gitignore so a scratch harness cannot be committed by accident.",
      "mechanizable": true

      "detail": "hasRole() was written for permission checks, where root passing every job is intended, but isCustomer/isIntegrator/isObserver reused it to decide record scope, so root became every restriction role at once and the customer scope (null id) emptied three lists. The dashboard escaped notice because it checks coordinator first.",
      "suggestedChange": "Separate \"may do this job\" from \"is this kind of subject\": give granting predicates the root bypass and make restricting/scoping predicates check explicit role membership, and unit test each predicate for root.",

      "detail": "Two separate browser failures (a stale New-customer draft, and a device form) came from the same shape: a form dialog rendered once with a controlled `open` keeps local `values` between opens.       "mechanizable": true

E3 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/lib/file-preview.ts:111–140

resolveFilePreviewKind 按 MIME/扩展名把文件分为 image/pdf/audio/video/text/markdown/ooxml/office/unsupported，并显式屏蔽 HTML/SVG/XML 等活动内容。

export function resolveFilePreviewKind(file: FileRecord): FilePreviewKind {
  const mimeType = file.mimeType.split(';', 1)[0]?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
  const extension = fileExtension(file.filename);
  if (
    ACTIVE_MIME_TYPES.has(mimeType) ||
    mimeType.endsWith('+xml') ||
    ACTIVE_EXTENSIONS.has(extension)
  ) {
    return 'unsupported';
  }
  if (mimeType === 'text/markdown' || extension === '.md') return 'markdown';
  if (resolveOfficeOpenXmlFormat(file)) return 'ooxml';
  if (OFFICE_MIME_TYPES.has(mimeType) || OFFICE_EXTENSIONS.has(extension)) {
    return 'office';
  }
  if (isSafeImagePreview(file)) return 'image';
  if (mimeType === 'application/pdf' || extension === '.pdf') return 'pdf';
  if (mimeType.startsWith('audio/')) return 'audio';
  if (mimeType.startsWith('video/')) return 'video';
  if (
    mimeType.startsWith('text/') ||
    mimeType === 'application/json' ||
    extension === '.json'
  ) {
    return 'text';
  }
  return 'unsupported';
}

E4 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:233–239

Skill 说明 DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 本地渲染、同源凭据限制、Bearer-only 内容的适配方式，以及 OOXML/PDF/text 取数凭据规则。

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.

E5 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:122–126

Skill 说明上传 Policy 从 create 派生并 stamp ownerId，且内置 content route 是公开的，必须在应用拥有的路径上注册认证与授权，禁止 router.use 通配。

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

E6 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:243–253

Skill 要求逐个格式用真实文件验证预览并覆盖未授权/跨域/失败场景，并列出无内置认证、无行级 ACL、无 Range/ETag、无 content sniffing 与恶意扫描等固有限制。

Verify upload → query → contentUrl → identical downloaded bytes, including batch upload, resource aliases and host prefixes. After materialization run the consuming App's typecheck/build and exercise upload, cancel/retry, remove, download and preview. Restricted files need anonymous, forbidden-user and permitted-user tests against both API and content routes. Inspectors check registration only.

For preview integration or changes, verify each of DOCX/XLSX/PPTX with real files in development and a served production build. Check relative same-origin URLs, an authorized and unauthorized session, cross-origin CORS success/failure, failed requests and invalid documents, and `download={false}`. Close or switch files while loading and after a failure: pending requests must abort, viewers must be destroyed, and the next file must render without stale state. Unit mocks and a successful build do not establish document rendering fidelity.

- Upload defaults are 5 MiB single / 20 MiB batch for the whole multipart body, including overhead. Direct Server uploads have no HTTP limit; UI maxSize checks an individual file. The Client supplies the multipart boundary.
- BODY_TOO_LARGE (413): reduce request size or adjust route limits. INVALID_FILE/INVALID_FILES (400): send native File values and a nonempty batch.
- INVALID_FILE_COLLECTION: first compare the migration name, route collection and Server repository argument; then await collections.get(logicalName) and check the active connection and generated metadata. SQLite physical text does not imply a broken datetime definition. Fix the specific lookup, metadata or schema problem and retry the same upload; do not bypass File Repository. Use a new migration for corrections to already-merged history.
- STORAGE_URL_UNAVAILABLE: configure a capable disk or stream mode.
- FILE_COMMIT_UNCERTAIN / FILE_CLEANUP_FAILED: reconcile database records and stored objects before retrying; uploads have no idempotency key.

There is no built-in route authentication, row ACL, Range/206, ETag, conditional download, resumable upload, physical cleanup, content sniffing or malware scan. Metadata deletion retains objects; cancelled forms may leave unlinked files. Implement the policies required by the business, including referenced-file deletion and orphan cleanup.

E7 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md:55–61

主 Skill 给出建模到路由绑定与配置的完整步骤：定义 collection/composite/recordAccess，注册 settings 与 workspace，保护每个路由，并同时验证 allowed 与 denied。

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

E8 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md:65–72

Skill 描述注册语义：未注册 collection 对所有人拒绝、composite 只组合其列出的授权、字段与关系操作代码拥有、关系写不继承目标集合约束。

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.database.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from the database; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- `settings`, `composite` and `database.collection` are catalog types: a check on an unregistered item or action is denied with `RESOURCE_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. `page`, `user`, `notification` and Hub types are record types that declare actions only; their grants use `id: '*'` for every record.
- A composite action composes exactly the grants it lists, never another composite. A data scope targets the one collection its grant actions name, whose type must declare `recordAccess` (`database.collection` does). Grant page access separately; a page grant never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require` needs an unconditional permit and rejects conditional decisions. Business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial or missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving collection grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the Repository route definition and bind each method to its composite action with `authz.database.authorizeRepository`. Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions need custom handlers. `authz.database.policyFor` folds collection grants; without its third argument it does not respect a business-action boundary.
- Scope every read and write in the workflow, including parent lookups. Keep multi-record writes transactional and include expected business state in mutation predicates. Authorization does not validate a quote's amount or its workflow transition.
- Fields and relation operations are code-owned. The permission workspace configures pages, business actions, their data scopes and settings items; do not build a second raw-field permission editor.
- Relation writes do not inherit the target collection's standalone constraints. Declare target record access and join-table fields explicitly; keep foreign-key fields from bypassing association controls.

The plugin's `skills/` directory is the source of truth; do not edit the synchronized application copy under `.agents/skills/`.

## Decide Whether to Use Scheduler

The primary reason to define tasks through Scheduler is **UI observability for business administrators**. Developers define schedules and execution logic in code. Business administrators use the application's task list and detail pages to view schedules, track individual executions, and enable or disable tasks when authorized.

Tasks that do not need to be viewed and tracked through the UI must not be managed by the Scheduler plugin. Use the application's Queue or existing background scheduling mechanism for those tasks. For administrator-visible tasks, deliver Client registration, access permissions, meaningful task names, and accurate final execution status together; successful server-side dispatch alone is incomplete.

## Then Choose the Execution Model

After deciding to use Scheduler, choose according to business complexity:

E19 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler/references/targets.md:80–100

references 要求检查 dispatch→业务 worker→终态通知→持久恢复全链路，reportCompletion 只在真实终态调用，inspect 恢复同一执行且不得重写历史。

Review the complete execution chain: dispatch → business worker consumption → terminal notification → persisted-state recovery. Scheduler runs its `schedule` worker only; the actual business worker must also be running on the selected connection/queue. Reconciliation observes execution state and cannot consume or execute the business Job.

In addition to dispatch and consumption, an asynchronous target needs all of the following:

1. **Terminal notification:** `registerTarget()` returns a handle; call `handle.reportCompletion(occurrenceId, reference, completion)` after actual success or exhausted retries. A failed attempt that will retry is not terminal failure. The handle only completes occurrences its own target started, so keep it on the Provider rather than re-deriving it. Queue Jobs are constructed through the application queue provider's Job factory, which supplies shared infrastructure such as database and logger rather than the application container; pass the handle through an explicit factory or service you own and do not assume a Job has `this.app`.
2. **Recovery queries:** implement `inspect(reference)` on the target and query persisted execution state. Reconciliation routes by the target type the occurrence recorded when it started, so a definition later retargeted elsewhere still inspects through the target that began the run.
3. **Reliable references:** notifications and inspection use the same `{ type, id }`, recoverable across processes. Do not use an in-process Map as the authoritative terminal state. Other execution systems use their own stable, non-conflicting reference types.

Queue Job success does not automatically mark Scheduler success. Returning `accepted` alone is incomplete. A notification can be lost or arrive before acceptance is persisted; inspection compensates for these cases. Nothing observes a Queue Job for you.

## Historical Occurrences After Retargeting

Changing a definition's target affects later executions; it does not transfer ownership of an existing occurrence. For example, if a definition changes from `app.export` to `workflow` while an export is waiting, that occurrence still belongs to `app.export`.

A valid completion requires all three conditions together:

1. Use the handle registered for the original target type recorded on the occurrence, not the new definition target's handle. Keep the original target integration available while its executions remain outstanding; a process restart can register that same type again.
2. Supply the original occurrenceId and its accepted reference, matching both `reference.type` and `reference.id`. Knowing the occurrenceId or original target type alone is insufficient. An ownership or reference mismatch is rejected with `REFERENCE_MISMATCH`.
3. Report the real executor's terminal outcome, after success or final failure rather than an attempt that will retry. A duplicate report of the same terminal status is idempotent; a conflicting terminal status is rejected with `COMPLETION_CONFLICT`.

If notification arrives before the accepted reference is persisted, it can return without completing the occurrence. Verify persisted history and let `inspect()` recover the original execution's state. Recovery routes through the occurrence's recorded target type and reference; do not launch replacement work or rewrite history to make a callback match.

export { IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_REALTIME_TOPIC, } from '../shared/realtime.js';
export function createRealtimeInAppStore(store, topic) {
    return {
        async deliver(input) {
            const item = await store.deliver(input);
            publishChange(topic, input.userId, 'created');
            return item;
        },
        list(input) {
            return store.list(input);
        },
        countUnread(userId) {
            return store.countUnread(userId);
        },
        async update(input) {
            const item = await store.update(input);
            if (item) {
                publishChange(topic, input.userId, input.action === 'delete' ? 'deleted' : input.action);
            }
            return item;
        },
        async markAllRead(userId) {
            const updated = await store.markAllRead(userId);
            if (updated > 0) {
                publishChange(topic, userId, 'read-all');
            }
            return updated;
        },
    };
}
function publishChange(topic, userId, change) {
    try {
        topic.publishFor(userId, {
            kind: 'inbox.changed',
            change,
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to publish in-app notification realtime event.', error);
    }
}
