E31 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/workflow-concepts.md:31–52

workflow-concepts 要求在原子/请求内/算法密集/单事务场景优先 typed code，仅在需要持久阶段、分支历史、后台耐久或运营可视性时使用 Workflow 加 typed code。

Prefer ordinary code alone when the behavior is atomic, request-bound, algorithm-heavy, or requires one transaction with no independently useful process state. Prefer Workflow plus typed code when the sequence, branch history, background durability, or operational visibility is itself part of the business requirement.

## Check that required process semantics exist

Architecture suitability is not enough; the target application must have Instruction contracts for the required control flow. The workflow plugin currently provides `condition`, `run`, and `terminate`. Other instructions are available only when an installed plugin exports them and the application supplies the same contracts to the source checker, Artifact builder, and runtime registry.

Do not simulate missing process semantics inside a long-running `run` script. Human approval, externally resumable waiting, loops, and subflows require their corresponding registered Instructions. Sending a notification can remain an ordinary Run service call; a dedicated notification Instruction is useful when workflows need a shared configuration and result contract. A `run` script can call a service or external system, but it cannot manufacture a durable pause/resume point or a new control-flow construct.

If the required Instruction does not exist:

- Keep ordinary business work in a typed service or `run` script.
- Add and register an Instruction when the missing behavior is reusable process-control semantics or a reusable operation that needs its own configuration and result contract. Follow [Custom Instructions](custom-instructions.md); ordinary one-off business actions stay in Run modules.
- Redesign or defer the workflow when the required lifecycle cannot be represented safely.

## Produce a decomposition before authoring

For a new feature or a migration from code, identify enough of the following to make the boundary explicit:

1. The business event that creates one process instance and the identity used for retries.
2. The per-invocation input versus administrator-tunable parameters.
3. The durable stages and supported branch decisions that belong in Workflow.
4. The atomic business actions that remain in typed services or `run` scripts.

E32 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/references/invocation-and-service-api.md:17–24

invocation 文档说明业务事件经 workflowRuntime.trigger 传入 workflow key 并得到 accepted/skipped，刻意没有通用公开的 POST /workflows/:key/trigger。

| Business/domain event starts a workflow                 | `workflowRuntime.trigger(key, input, options?)` | workflow key              | `accepted`/`skipped` receipt; accepted execution is asynchronous |
| Authorized administrator manually executes a definition | authenticated management HTTP API               | definition id             | persisted run list item                                          |
| Manage/inspect workflows and runs                       | authenticated management HTTP API               | mostly definition/run ids | typed view/list/detail                                           |
| Browser/admin client                                    | authenticated `/api` routes                     | definition/run ids        | `{ data }` or paged response                                     |

There is intentionally no generic public `POST /workflows/:key/trigger`. A cron, webhook, route, or domain module authenticates and validates its own event, constructs the declared input, then calls the internal service.

B06 (focused round). Verified: multi-file upload of all 5 provided valid fixtures succeeded with saved business association on order SO-2026-0014; the association persisted across page reload; PNG preview rendered real image content and PDF preview rendered real text content (not just filenames); all 5 downloaded files were sha256-identical to the provided samples; corrupt.png and unsupported.exe each produced explicit failure feedback and were not added. One required part of B06 - in-app content display of the valid DOCX/XLSX/PPTX files - is BLOCKED by the test browser environment: those previews show 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' The app's Office renderer is a module blob Worker; the agent-browser allowed-domain Worker wrapper gives it a bootstrap with a top-level 'await import()' before the app code runs, so the init/parse messages posted at worker startup are dispatched during that await and dropped before self.onmessage is set. Re-posting the identical messages to the same live worker returned documentSessionOpened, and plain unguarded Chrome delivered the same immediate module-worker message; the queued-message behaviour is standard, so this is a browser-harness module-blob-Worker limitation (moduleBlobWorker handling), not a business defect, and no application repair is requested.

01

实际上传 PNG、PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 小型合法文件并保存业务关联；逐格式检查显示的内容而非文件名，刷新后重新预览、下载；损坏或不支持的文件给出失败提示。文件测试样例由测试准备生成或提供，不能把浏览器 QA 自行生成文件当成浏览器操作。

环境受阻：Every B06 operation was exercised and verified EXCEPT in-app content display of the valid Office files (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX). Those show the explicit in-app error 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' with only a 'Download file' fallback. Root cause is the test browser's global Worker wrapper, not the application: the app's Office renderer is a module blob Worker whose script sets self.onmessage synchronously, and it is posted {type:'init',wasmUrl:.../docx_parser_bg-CiTwQZUK.wasm} and {type:'parse',...} immediately after creation. The agent-browser allowed-domain guard rewrites the worker into a bootstrap that first performs a top-level 'await import(<original blob>)'; during that top-level await the browser dispatches the already-queued init/parse messages while the app's handler is not yet installed, so the messages are dropped and the worker never renders. Re-posting the identical init/parse messages to the same live worker later returned {type:'documentSessionOpened'} (so the worker and file are fine), and a plain unguarded Chrome 153 delivered an immediate message to an equivalent synchronous-handler module blob Worker. The queued-message guarantee is standard worker behaviour, so this is a browser-environment limitation of module blob Worker handling (cf. preflight capability moduleBlobWorker/moduleBlobWorkerRequest), not a business defect; per the task guidance the application must not be required to replace global Worker behaviour for the test environment. PNG/PDF content rendering, multi-file upload with saved business association, refresh persistence, byte-identical re-download and corrupt/unsupported failure feedback all passed.

  3. Clicked Preview for sample.png; the modal rendered an <img> whose src is /main/api/service-orders/14/attachments/<id>/content (natural 32x32, displayed ~870px) showing the real solid-blue-square content.
  4. Clicked Preview for sample.pdf; the modal rendered data-pdf-preview with a <canvas width=918 height=1188> containing 2908 sampled dark pixels, i.e. real rendered text content.
  5. Clicked Preview for sample.pptx, sample.xlsx and sample.docx in turn; each modal showed 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' with a 'Download file' button and no rendered content.
  6. Downloaded all 5 listed attachments via their Download buttons and compared sha256 to the provided fixtures manifest.

  9. Uploaded the provided unsupported.exe and clicked Upload attachment; an alert 'Unsupported file type (.exe). Only PNG, JPEG, PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files are supported.' appeared and no attachment was added.

Diagnosed the Office renderer worker: hooked Worker/URL.createObjectURL, captured that the worker receives {type:'init',wasmUrl:...docx_parser_bg-CiTwQZUK.wasm} and {type:'parse',...} but never replies; re-posted the same two messages to the live worker, which then replied {type:'documentSessionOpened'}; confirmed the worker script assigns self.onmessage synchronously and that the guard bootstrap adds a top-level await import(); reproduced the message loss in a minimal guarded module blob worker and compared against plain unguarded Chrome 153 which delivered the same immediate message.

观察结果

  2. PNG preview displayed actual image content (img on /main/api/service-orders/14/attachments/<id>/content), not merely the filename.
  3. PDF preview displayed actual rendered text content (data-pdf-preview canvas 918x1188, 2908 sampled dark pixels).
  4. Downloaded files were byte-identical to the provided fixtures: sample.png eafcdecc1468f7b18a15a7d22c494ab7e14a435f0560798ad463efc5e14f3490, sample.pdf 6cb99aa93ea5607509fc676bf82e835728a7c44aa9f584a0974600765c0f8fc3, sample.docx 06408d7e3a01fd82bc32240dbd035d6366ac701f50c1a90f12eb49f47288cd6e, sample.xlsx aebb2e45d35551150c56edd7bf7e09e46cc1423a6a99e3545c593c946f179b4e, sample.pptx 304a16d1c38e3b7fde3accdaff511811be3200227e314c6996c7e741fe8d71cc.
  5. corrupt.png produced the explicit alert 'The file content does not match its extension; it may be corrupt or not a real file.' and was not added.
  6. unsupported.exe produced the explicit alert 'Unsupported file type (.exe). Only PNG, JPEG, PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files are supported.' and was not added.
  7. BLOCKER (base environment, not app): valid DOCX/XLSX/PPTX previews all show 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' The app's Office parser is a module blob Worker; the agent-browser allowed-domain wrapper gives it a bootstrap with a top-level 'await import()' before the app code runs. The {init}/{parse} messages posted at worker creation are dispatched during that await and dropped because self.onmessage is not yet set. Re-posting the identical messages to the same live worker returned documentSessionOpened, and plain unguarded Chrome 153 delivered the same immediate module-worker message, so the message loss is introduced by the test browser's Worker wrapper. Preflight reports moduleBlobWorker/moduleBlobWorkerRequest true, so no application repair is requested.

完整原始验收要求
以下仅为业务浏览器验收。逐条记录实际操作、观察、证据；模块代码/Skill 检查见独立评审评论，不能用页面通过代替代码评审，也不能要求浏览器 QA 伪造源码证据。

B01. 以主管、华东工程师、华南工程师、协作工程师、观察员分别登录，验证各自入口及允许/禁止的业务操作；角色切换不保留前一账号的权限。
B02. 新增客户和设备、编辑后刷新，验证值回填与保存；重复设备编号、无效客户设备关联有清晰反馈。
B03. 搜索、区域/状态筛选、分页、详情刷新和返回列表正常，结果不能混入无权访问的记录。
B04. 按草稿、提交、分派、处理、待确认、退回、再次处理、关闭跑通一张工单；验证转派/取消原因和关闭后的限制。
B05. 快速重复提交/关闭同一工单不产生重复业务结果；不能跳过必要状态直接关闭。
B06. 实际上传 PNG、PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 小型合法文件并保存业务关联；逐格式检查显示的内容而非文件名，刷新后重新预览、下载；损坏或不支持的文件给出失败提示。文件测试样例由测试准备生成或提供，不能把浏览器 QA 自行生成文件当成浏览器操作。
B07. 用无工单访问权的普通用户尝试打开工单及其附件，不能显示内容；观察员看不到内部成本字段且不能编辑。
B08. 默认知识可读范围、指定工单跨区分享、分享撤销、保密限制分别生效；分享不能自动授予原本没有的操作。
B09. 分派后收件人消息中心出现对应持久消息，可跳转、已读/未读、删除；刷新/重新登录后状态正确，其他用户看不到；断开再恢复连接后可补齐消息。
B10. 保存成功、必填校验和一次真实失败都有正确的即时反馈，失败后未保存内容可恢复，不以 toast 冒充站内信。
B11. 从自动受理的执行记录查看步骤与实际工单结果；失败场景保留失败原因，恢复不删除旧记录或重复通知。
B12. 管理员查看巡检/超期计划，使用测试环境提供的短周期或受控触发观察实际执行；执行结束时业务结果一致，重复执行不重复创建当天巡检；停用后不再产生新任务。
B13. 看板数值与当前用户能看到的工单一致，状态变更和筛选后更新；不同岗位不出现越权统计。
B14. 管理员创建、停用、重新启用测试用户并维护岗位；停用后的原会话不可继续使用，其他业务账户不受影响。只读业务管理员可查看数据结构，但不能改表。
B15. 切换中英文，逐页检查导航、字段、弹窗、文件组件、消息及错误反馈；刷新/直接地址访问正常，不能只有中文静态页面。
B16. 服务助手未配置时准确提示且手工流程正常；配置测试模型的扩展轮次才验证真实问答、上下文范围、建议草稿、确认/拒绝和对话恢复。外部通知同理：没有测试服务标为扩展场景未执行，不声称实投成功。

API 密钥的 HTTP 调用、服务端越权/幂等、代码边界、安装引导和 Hub 发布属于独立集成/模块评审，不将它们冒充浏览器截图验收。测试角色账号可通过管理员 UI 创建，统一使用本轮测试密码配置；测试准备缺失、基础环境失败与真实业务缺陷分别报告。

B06 (focused round). Verified: multi-file upload of all 5 provided valid fixtures succeeded with saved business association on order SO-2026-0014; the association persisted across page reload; PNG preview rendered real image content and PDF preview rendered real text content (not just filenames); all 5 downloaded files were sha256-identical to the provided samples; corrupt.png and unsupported.exe each produced explicit failure feedback and were not added. One required part of B06 - in-app content display of the valid DOCX/XLSX/PPTX files - is BLOCKED by the test browser environment: those previews show 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' The app's Office renderer is a module blob Worker; the agent-browser allowed-domain Worker wrapper gives it a bootstrap with a top-level 'await import()' before the app code runs, so the init/parse messages posted at worker startup are dispatched during that await and dropped before self.onmessage is set. Re-posting the identical messages to the same live worker returned documentSessionOpened, and plain unguarded Chrome delivered the same immediate module-worker message; the queued-message behaviour is standard, so this is a browser-harness module-blob-Worker limitation (moduleBlobWorker handling), not a business defect, and no application repair is requested.
